mapper.sql: select c.issue_id, c.issue_no, c.person_id, c.person_name, c.person_dept, c.violation_type, c.violation_date, c.violation_desc, c.amount, c.amount_recovered, c.source_type, c.severity, c.check_deadline, c.status, c.warn_level, c.handle_type, c.handle_date, c.handle_desc, c.punish_id, c.rectify_id, c.close_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, case when c.check_deadline is null then null else datediff(c.check_deadline, curdate()) end as remain_days, ri.status as rectify_status from jc_conduct_issue c left join jc_rectify_issue ri on ri.issue_id = c.rectify_id and ri.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select max(issue_no) from jc_conduct_issue where issue_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into jc_conduct_issue ( issue_no, person_id, person_name, person_dept, violation_type, violation_date, source_type, severity, check_deadline, status, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{issueNo}, #{personId}, #{personName}, #{personDept}, #{violationType}, #{violationDate}, #{sourceType}, #{severity}, #{checkDeadline}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.delete: update jc_conduct_issue set del_flag = '1' where issue_id = #{issueId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_conduct_issue where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from jc_conduct_issue where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(1) from jc_conduct_issue where del_flag = '0' and status = '2'
select count(1) from jc_conduct_issue where del_flag = '0' and status = '3'
select coalesce(sum(amount_recovered), 0) from jc_conduct_issue where del_flag = '0' and amount_recovered is not null

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_conduct_issue c left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_conduct_type' and dd.dict_value = c.violation_type where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.violation_type, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_conduct_issue c left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_conduct_severity' and dd.dict_value = c.severity where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.severity, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_conduct_issue c left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_conduct_source' and dd.dict_value = c.source_type where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.source_type, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select c.person_dept as name, count(1) as value from jc_conduct_issue c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.person_dept is not null and c.person_dept != '' group by c.person_dept order by value desc limit 10

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_conduct_issue c left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_conduct_handle' and dd.dict_value = c.handle_type where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '2' group by c.handle_type, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select date_format(c.violation_date, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value from jc_conduct_issue c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.violation_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(c.violation_date, '%Y-%m') order by name
